Predicates:
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Likes($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x like y?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Sees($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x see y?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?

Facts:
Green(BaldEagle, True) ::: The bald eagle is green.
Likes(BaldEagle, Squirrel, True) ::: The bald eagle likes the squirrel.
Likes(BaldEagle, Tiger, True) ::: The bald eagle likes the tiger.
Nice(Bear, True) ::: The bear is nice.
Round(Bear, True) ::: The bear is round.
Likes(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: The bear likes the bald eagle.
Likes(Bear, Tiger, True) ::: The bear likes the tiger.
Young(Squirrel, True) ::: The squirrel is young.
Likes(Squirrel, Bear, True) ::: The squirrel likes the bear.
Needs(Squirrel, BaldEagle, True) ::: The squirrel needs the bald eagle.
Sees(Squirrel, Tiger, True) ::: The squirrel sees the tiger.
Cold(Tiger, True) ::: The tiger is cold.
Likes(Tiger, Bear, True) ::: The tiger likes the bear.
Likes(Tiger, Squirrel, True) ::: The tiger likes the squirrel.
Needs(Tiger, Bear, True) ::: The tiger needs the bear.
Sees(Tiger, Bear, True) ::: The tiger sees the bear.

Rules:
Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) && Likes(BaldEagle, Bear, True) >>> Needs(BaldEagle, Tiger, True) ::: If something needs the bald eagle and the bald eagle likes the bear then the bald eagle needs the tiger.
Needs($x, Squirrel, True) >>> Needs($x, Tiger, True) ::: If something needs the squirrel then it needs the tiger.
Green($x, True) >>> Needs($x, Squirrel, True) ::: If something is green then it needs the squirrel.
Needs($x, Bear, True) && Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Likes(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: If something needs the bear and it needs the bald eagle then the bear likes the bald eagle.
Likes($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: If something likes the bald eagle then it is young.
Likes($x, Bear, True) && Sees($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Needs($x, Bear, True) ::: If something likes the bear and it sees the bald eagle then it needs the bear.
Round($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: Round things are green.
Sees($x, Squirrel, True) && Likes(Squirrel, Bear, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: If something sees the squirrel and the squirrel likes the bear then it is cold.
Needs($x, Bear, True) && Green(Bear, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: If something needs the bear and the bear is green then it is round.
